notes.title: NEW RELEASE - HEX PICROSS
notes.notes:
Hi Players, 

Today we released a new game on Steam called Hex Picross

This game is a picross on a hexagonal grid with a beautiful minimol design and a relaxing sound enviroment.

More info and trailer on steam page store:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2113370/Hex_Picross/

notes.title: Update - New Levels Included
notes.notes:
12 new levels were included, from 39 to 50.

Their idea is to include new challenges with:

- Increased number of cannons and Hexons in the levels

- Greater diversity of cannon sum, now with random numbers

- More cannons to destroy a hexon

- Almost all Hexons are "connected" by the cannons, making the levels more challenging

notes.title: New screen settings
notes.notes:
A system has been included to check and adjust the screen according to your monitor.

Screens available at this time: 5:4, 4:3, 3:2, 16:9, 16:10

Any problems you have, please post in the community!

notes.title: Update - In response to your requests
notes.notes:
In response to your requests, some improvements have been included:

- The possibility to move Hexons within the hexagrid

- The possibility to disarm and rearm cannons without restarting the game
